goal.insight: Show the complete event-driven message flow from producer microservices through Kafka topics, Schema Registry validation, consumer microservices, Dead Letter Queues, and retry paths as an integrated architecture diagram
Visually emphasize the Kafka topic routing layer as the central hub, clearly showing which microservices publish to and consume from which topics with distinguishable connection paths
Highlight the Dead Letter Queue and retry strategy paths as distinct error-handling flows, visually separating them from the happy-path message routes using color or line style differentiation
Depict the monitoring and alerting chain as a cross-cutting concern that observes multiple components, showing metric collection points and alert trigger connections across the architecture
Show Schema Registry as a validation checkpoint that interacts with both producers and consumers, emphasizing its role as a gatekeeper in the message serialization pipeline
